solar_parameters.logg_basis: IAU nominal solar mass + radius (logg fixed to ~0.001 dex)

interpretation: 90 input field candidates, full native depth extent (previous solves dropped one bottom row). Method/cell spread and internal column closure are NOT independent accuracy, EOS/equilibrium validation, line contribution or abundance uncertainty. No native reference at solar targets. logtau[-3,0] uses fixed native source rows, not rounded interpolated tau, and is a declared diagnostic subset only. All three field conventions retained. No RT/SE or new opacity packet.
